name: [Sector] Energy
description: Sector-focused dashboard for the Energy industry, showing threat actors, malware, attack patterns, vulnerabilities, and geographic threat origins.

parameters.content:
## Please note that for this dashboard to populate correctly, it is HIGHLY recommended that you enable the "OpenCTI Dataset" connector.
### This dashboard and its widgets can be reconfigured to track threats targeting a different sector by replacing *Energy* with any other sector available in your instance.
**NOTE:** The *Relative time*, *Start date* and *End date* drop menus at the top of the screen can be used to adjust the time filters for all following widgets.
### The below *Map* widgets illustrate the countries where Threat Actors targeting the Energy sector are *located at* and where Intrusion Sets targeting the Energy sector *originate from*.
### The below *Number* widgets illustrate the amount of relationships that exist between the Energy sector entity and all other entities that exist in your OpenCTI instance.
### The below *Map* widget illustrates the countries that Threat Actors targeting the Energy sector are *targeting* and that Intrusion Sets targeting the Energy sector are *targeting*.

### The below *Horizontal bar* widgets illustrate the specific entities that have the most relationships with the Energy sector. Each widget represents a category of entity type.
#### Horizontal bar widgets are interactive - clicking on an entity will take you to its details page.
### The below *Line* widgets illustrate over time the volume of entities created or updated that have a relationship with the Energy sector.
### The below *Donut* widgets illustrate the specific Creators that have imported entities related to the Energy sector along with their percentage of contribution.
